_comment: Disease -> up/down gene signature mapping for the DLEPS (ONNX) build.
The signature files live in data/ and hold one ENTREZGENE_ACC per line,
no header. A disease is servable as soon as both files exist; entries
whose files are missing are listed but rejected with an actionable error.
Adding a disease is a matter of dropping the two files into data/ and
adding an entry here -- no code change.
NOTE: 'Obesity' has no signature file in this repository yet. The entry
is kept so the tool reports 'signature missing' instead of 'unknown
disease'; drop Obesity_up / Obesity_down into data/ to enable it.
